title: Sponsored: Precision Multitrade Services offers property maintenance with a 24-hour call-out
excerpt: Advertisement feature: Precision Multitrade Services is a family-run property maintenance business covering plumbing, bathrooms, kitchens, flooring and tiling across the North West.
body:
This is a paid-for advertisement feature.

Precision Multitrade Services is a family-run property maintenance business based in Greater Manchester and working across the North West.

Its services include plumbing maintenance, general property maintenance, bathroom and kitchen fitting, flooring, tiling, wall panelling and wet wall installation. It also offers a 24-hour emergency call-out.

The business says it takes on jobs of any size and aims for competitive prices and careful workmanship. It is listed on Checkatrade, where customers can read reviews.

Its website does not give a street address or opening hours.

title: Sponsored: Rochdale Martial Arts Academy teaches judo and Brazilian jiu jitsu to children and adults
excerpt: Advertisement feature: Rochdale Martial Arts Academy runs judo and Brazilian jiu jitsu classes for children and adults, from complete beginners to competitors.
body:
This is a paid-for advertisement feature.

Rochdale Martial Arts Academy teaches judo and Brazilian jiu jitsu to children and adults.

Its children's classes take pupils from complete beginners through to competition level, and the academy says they are designed to build technique, discipline and confidence.

Adult classes are open to all levels. The academy says no previous experience, particular fitness level or equipment is needed to start, and that members can train at their own pace.

For those who want to compete, it runs sessions covering grip fighting, transitions, match conditioning and sparring.

The academy offers a free first class. Its timetable and membership options are on its website, which does not give prices or a street address in text, so newcomers should ring or email first.

Contact: 07484 794474 or info@rochdalemartialartsacademy.co.uk.

title: Sponsored: The Physiotherapy Clinic offers physiotherapy, Pilates and home visits in Rochdale
excerpt: Advertisement feature: The Physiotherapy Clinic in Rochdale offers physiotherapy for joint, muscle and sports problems, small Pilates classes and home visits.
body:
This is a paid-for advertisement feature.

The Physiotherapy Clinic offers physiotherapy in Rochdale and is listed at 557 Bury Road, Bamford.

The clinic says it is registered with the Health and Care Professions Council. It treats joint and muscle problems, sports injuries, chronic pain and respiratory conditions, among others, using manual therapy, exercise, advice, electrotherapy and acupuncture.

It also runs Pilates classes, which it says are led by chartered physiotherapists trained by the Australian Physiotherapy and Pilates Institute and kept small. Remedial massage, homoeopathy and reiki are offered as well.

Home visits can be arranged for people who cannot get to the clinic. The clinic says its ground floor has disabled access.

Its website does not list prices or opening hours. Anyone with a health concern should speak to their GP or the clinic directly about what is suitable for them.

Contact: 01706 522277.

body:
This is a paid-for advertisement feature.

Raf's Cleaning Service Ltd is a family carpet cleaning business based in Oldham and established in 2014.

It covers most of Greater Manchester, and the areas listed on its website include Rochdale, Middleton and Bury.

title: Sponsored: CTML offers lock repairs, key cutting, master key systems and safes
excerpt: Advertisement feature: CTML Ltd is a Manchester locksmith offering lock repairs and rebuilds, key cutting, master key systems, alarms and safe work.
body:
This is a paid-for advertisement feature.

CTML Ltd is a locksmith based at Unit 1, Arena Court, Mirabel Street, in Manchester city centre.

Its services include lock repairs, from cutting a new key to rebuilding a lock in its workshop when a replacement is no longer made. It also cuts keys for many kinds of lock, including safes and windows.

For homes it offers a single key set up to open every lock in the house. For hotels, offices and factories it designs master key systems.

The company also installs and services emergency exit hardware and wireless intruder alarms, and opens and maintains safes and vaults. It says it draws on more than 90 years of experience.

Its website does not say which areas it covers, so customers in the Rochdale borough should ask when they ring.

Contact: 0161 839 0201 or service@ctml.co.uk.
